title: Weekly energy and deep work review
transcript: Sunday review. This week I got energy from long walks and from dinner with Maya. The sapper was context switching between design and billing work. I want to carry forward protecting two deep work blocks next week, and I need to renew the App Store account on Tuesday. Overall grateful and a little tired.
